closing.summary: Big strengths are magnesium, fibre, and protein, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin E, low protein quality, and low omega 3. It is good for bone health, digestion, and heart health because calcium and magnesium gives the bone-health case something to work with, fibre supports digestion and steadier meals, and fibre supports the heart-health side.
